citations.text:
Trial registration

Clinical Trials Registry – India (Indian Medical Research) CTRI/2017/11/010474.
The trial was “retrospectively registered” with Clinical Trials Registry – India (Indian Medical Research).
Post-operative visits were scheduled at day1, 2 weeks, 1 month and 6 months.
The main outcome measures were anatomical and visual outcome at the end of 6 months.

other_measurements.label: Baseline BCVA
named: The presenting best-corrected visual acuity (BCVA) and intraocular pressure (IOP) were recorded.
second_look: Mean BCVA at post-operative 1-month in Group A and Group B was logMAR 0.68 ± 0.25 (Snellen equivalent 20/96) and logMAR 0.54 ± 0.19 (Snellen equivalent 20/69) (p = 0.016) respectively.

other_measurements.label: BCVA at 6 months
named: The main outcome measures were anatomical and visual outcome at the end of 6 months.
result: Mean BCVA at post-operative 6-month in Group A and B was logMAR 0.65 ± 0.25 (Snellen equivalent 20/89) and logMAR 0.53 ± 0.20 (Snellen equivalent 20/68) respectively (p = 0.060).

planned: Student’s t-test/ Mann-Whitney U test was used to find out the significant difference of continuous variables between the two study groups.
Wilcoxon sign rank test was used to find out the difference between pre- and post-operative visual acuity.
